sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 34 / check 33; Internal Quality Checks row 34 with Mukesh annotation on combined flows)
.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Known false positives: one criterion covering a whole flow, checks 26/28/33)
evidence: Reviewed all 28 criteria (2 gates, 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual) for a criterion that lists several requirements and then waives most of them. None does. Each functional criterion states numbered legs plus a 'Fails if' summary; where the summary is narrower than the body (e.g. wall_mentions_and_links Part B body requires M-12 suggestions to include Sian Lloyd and Paul Marsh, but 'Fails if' only names Dev/Gwen/Paul exclusions; hold_scope_and_release step 2 'JUDGE-H1 is marked On hold' and step 6 search positive control are not repeated in 'Fails if'), tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:32-33 resolves it to one bar: 'A criterion passes only if every numbered leg and every listed positive control holds; its "Fails if" line names the main failures but never excuses a leg it does not mention.' Multi-part criteria (signin_and_client_scope, wall_mentions_and_links, deleted_and_expired_messages, edits_and_stale_edit, sent_once_in_order, search_and_transcript) end with 'Both/All parts must hold' - conjunctive single bars, which the skill's known-false-positive list and the Internal sheet annotation (combined flows) explicitly permit. Scope statements are clarifications, not waivers of enumerated items: persistence ('grades only durability' - single equality bar on the step-c list, consistent with its Fails line), constraints gate ('does not grade roles...' after enumerating only persistence/visibility), render gate ('Assign 1 only if every check holds'), timer_changes leg 2 (lists acceptable refusal shapes, with one bar: neither '2,400' nor '4,200' appears). Visual matter_sidebar has the only conditional waiver ('If no matter shows an unread count when you look, judge identification and selection only') - it waives one of three anchor elements only when the state lacks counts, is state-tolerant (functional run leaves unread posts for Gwen), and unread correctness is graded functionally in unread_and_new_messages_line, so the judge still has one target per observed state. Broken-app probe: an app that shows a blank preview instead of 'not available' for Dev (wall_mentions_and_links A) or omits Sian from M-12 suggestions cannot pass because prompt.md:32-33 forbids excusing unmentioned legs. Conforming-alternative probe: an app placing the matter list on its own screen, or refusing earlier-versions replay with an empty list, is explicitly accepted, so it is not failed by a second hidden target. Minor note (no defect): polish prompt.md lacks the functional prompt's 'Fails if never excuses a leg' sentence; refusal_in_place's body leg 'sign in with the right password: no reason is shown' is not in its Fails line, but the body is assertive and the criterion still has one bar. Static textual review only; no runtime evidence is required for this row.
